hardware.evidence: The second-pass brass latch is visible on the camera-facing centre stile at the lower meeting rail, though it is small in the room capture.

material_response.evidence: Warm timber stays separate from the pale glazing; outdoor forms show through the panes, with the known mild cool cast still visible.

surface_variation.evidence: The stained outer casing and lighter inner sash members retain different wood values, while the panes carry the outdoor scene.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: Five transom panes, lower sash rails, a central meeting stile, and the visible latch form a readable window assembly; the approved target has four upper panes.
